column3: (Anti-clickjacking header missing: every page must send X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
(Cookie without HttpOnly: the app sets no cookies, so any cookie is a regression)
(Vulnerable JS library: e.g. Swagger UI's DOMPurify; update the dependency)
(CSP: img-src https: on the frontend and style-src 'unsafe-inline' for styles; scripts are never inline)
(HTTP Basic for admin: only ever over HTTPS in production, and admin routes also need TOTP)
(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp would block cross-origin card images)
(Subresource Integrity: the Google Fonts stylesheet is generated per browser, so it can't be pinned)
(Sec-Fetch-Dest: a request header sent by browsers, not something the server sets)
(Base64 disclosure: data URIs and hashes inside the built JS bundles)
(Suspicious comments: false positives in the minified React bundle)
(Storable and cacheable content: informational, public catalogue)
(Timestamp disclosure: false positives on numeric ids and prices)
